item.text: Helichrysum melaleucum is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae, described by Rchb. ex Holl in 1830. It is endemic to Portugal’s Madeira Archipelago and is not protected under Portuguese or European Community legislation. [s1:p1–p2, s1:p4–p7]
